verses.text: <pb/><t>'Ya Ubangiji, na rabu da girmankai,</t> <t>Na bar yin fariya,</t> <t>Ba ruwana da manyan al'amura,</t> <t>Ba ruwana kuma da zantuttukan da suka fi ƙarfina.</t>
<t>Amma na haƙura, raina a kwance,</t> <t>Kamar jinjirin da yake kwance jalisan a hannun mahaifiyarsa,</t> <t>Haka zuciyata take kwance.</t>
<t>Ya Isra'ila, ka dogara ga Ubangiji,</t> <t>Daga yanzu har abada!</t>
